items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: And I played occasionally make-up bands, Kid Howard, and Chic, and different fellas. A band would have just gone down for that day, Kid Howard band, or Kid Chic.

ctx.x: I played Rene, Kid Rene, played one couple with Chris Kelly, played with the Joan, the Tuxedo band. I never did play any with the Eureka. And I played occasionally make-up bands, Kid Howard, and Chic, and different fellas. A band would have just gone down for that day, Kid Howard band, or Kid Chic.
What kind of a brass band would Rene have?
